items.title: Continuity across the three offers is the strategic unit
items.summary: Source observation: POM presents Invoice, Payment and Collect as connected offers.
items.implication: Inference: Preserve shared receivable identity across delivery and follow-up; measure end-to-end outcomes while keeping commercial entitlements explicit.

items.title: Payment experience retains external settlement authority
items.summary: Source observation: The Payment page describes payment directly to the creditor's bank account.
items.implication: Inference: Model provider events, reconciliation authority and pending status without inventing a POM customer-funds ledger.

items.title: Inclusive delivery needs an operational fallback
items.summary: Source observation: The Intermaris case describes targeted tenant letters and a postal alternative after digital non-response.
items.implication: Inference: Provide suitable contact choices and failure queues. Treat tracking as imperfect and retain support for people without digital access.

items.title: Completed-looking payments can later require recovery
items.summary: Source observation: The UvA/HvA case describes following up returned direct debits with payment requests.
items.implication: Inference: Separate reversals and delayed evidence from final settlement, so a returned payment does not create uncontrolled duplicate demands.

items.title: Resolution choices matter when immediate payment is impractical
items.summary: Source observation: Payment Coach describes deferral, arrangements and other choices bounded by business rules.
items.implication: Inference: Propose clear terms, explicit acceptance, human exceptions and maintained-commitment measurement; these controls are not claimed as current POM implementation.

items.title: Plan acceptance differs from sustained fulfillment
items.summary: Source observation: POM's arrangement-bot page describes reminders and installment adjustments.
items.implication: Inference: Measure later fulfillment and reassessment; keep arranged exposure separate from cash and route unsupported situations to accountable staff.

items.title: Contact recommendations need visible policy boundaries
items.summary: Source observation: The POM AI page describes time, channel and tone predictions and human control.
items.implication: Inference: Record recommendation version, eligible inputs and override reasons. Collection policy remains the final authority for permitted contact.

items.title: Vendor uplift needs a local comparison before investment
items.summary: Source observation: POM publishes AI improvement percentages without a complete experimental method on the reviewed page.
items.implication: Inference: Do not import these percentages as baselines or universal targets. Define cohort, holdout, observation window and complaint stop rules.

items.title: Implementation depends on multi-party responsibilities
items.summary: Source observation: POM's partner page lists integration, financial and social partners and a modular platform.
items.implication: Inference: Separate source, payment and support boundaries, with an accepted handoff and responsible owner for each integration.

items.title: Housing warrants distinct customer outcomes
items.summary: Source observation: Vortex identifies housing-focused Mind2Pay within POM group expansion.
items.implication: Inference: Model tenant support and current-rent continuity distinctly; this does not establish a fourth standalone current product.

items.title: Creditor identity shapes payment trust
items.summary: Source observation: The UvA/HvA case emphasizes creditor-branded reminders and multilingual templates.
items.implication: Inference: Evaluate recognizable identity, language and correction access before optimizing conversion.

items.title: Payers are participants whose outcomes matter
items.summary: Source observation: POM's company narrative addresses organizations' and their customers' financial health.
items.implication: Inference: Give constrained payers and authorized advisers explicit jobs and guardrails even when the creditor buys the software.

items.title: Privacy context is not a control specification
items.summary: Source observation: POM publishes a privacy statement; GDPR provides primary data-protection context.
items.implication: Inference: Use minimal case data, explicit authority and purpose-limited retention; validate actual processing terms and local policies before implementation.

items.title: Published scale needs its original scope
items.summary: Source observation: The POM Netherlands overview and Vortex profile report different customer-count scopes.
items.implication: Inference: Keep statements separate, do not infer growth between them, and leave operational baselines unmeasured.
